verdict.rationale: Steel is a browser-automation platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no versioning, change history, or rollback of automation definitions. Agent Traces lets users review past runs as timelines and exports, but that is observability of a single execution, not versioning or rollback of the automation itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
